verdict.rationale: LanceDB's first-party docs include a dedicated reranking section that tells users to "Use a reranker to improve search relevance," and that section works in the context of hybrid search. The pack does not name which built-in or integrated reranking models exist, how they are configured, or how they plug into the query API, so the depth of the capability is unproven. Missing for 10: named built-in/first-party reranker models (e.g. cross-encoder or hosted rerank providers), API/configuration details for applying a reranker to query results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can rerank search results with built-in or first-party-integrated reranking models
